Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern OutdoorThrow Pillow, 20" x 20", Black and White
Colors: Jet
Made in USA and imported This modern geometric pillow adds a fun pop of color to your outdoor patio. Back of pillow is solid black-colored fabric. 20"L x 20"W Pillow Spot clean. Put in dryer on low heat for 20 minutes to release wrinkles or use garment steamer. Do not iron. Pillow insert arrives in vacuum-sealed bag. Carefully remove insert from packaging. and let it fully expand before putting inside of pillow cover.
